international.title: Florida mechanic found guilty of murdering British woman who attorney says came to US to die
international.summary: Dwain Hall was convicted of stabbing Sonia Exelby, a music teacher who prosecutors say suffered from mental illness A Florida mechanic has been found guilty of stabbing to death a British music teacher, who he convinced to travel to the United States. Dwain Hall, an auto repair and tow truck driver groomed 32-year-old Sonia Exelby from Portsmouth, England, on a fetish website before luring her to the US. Continue reading...
